**Live +LM: 32.7×, 0.328 J/audio-s, 5.54% · Final: 16.8×, 5.00%**

![Isosyll: Always Listening, Barely Computing. Single-core throughput, pooled WER, and active-core energy across all 12 timed public CPU speech recognizers vs. Isosyll on the 730-utterance LibriSpeech DEV panel](docs/paper/money.png)

**Figure 1.** Isosyll vs. all 12 timed public CPU speech recognizers on one pinned Zen 2 core: live +LM runs at 32.7× (0.328 J/audio-s, 5.54% WER at 160 ms; +0.81 pp on unselected DEV) and the utterance-end commit pass reaches 5.00% at 16.8× vs. Zipformer INT8 at 14.0× (0.573 J/audio-s, 5.25%). [Paper](docs/paper/paper.pdf) · [Release record](docs/ultra/releases/v4.0.0.md).

- **Fastest & lowest power.** On one quiet Zen 2 core, **Isosyll live +LM** at 160 ms runs at **32.7×** real time and **0.328 J/audio-s** (**5.54%** panel / **6.10%** full DEV, **109 MB** RAM), **2.33×** the paired throughput of Zipformer INT8 at **57%** of its energy per audio-second (paired, same blocks). The 320 ms chunk is **33.3×** and **0.316 J/audio-s** (**5.50%** panel / **5.87%** full DEV, paired **2.40×** at **55%** energy). Greedy mode reaches **34.2×** in **74 MB** RAM (**6.23%** WER).
- **Best accuracy from the same weights.** At utterance ends, the commit pass on the exact same 60 MB INT8 weights reaches **5.00%** panel / **5.22%** full DEV WER (vs. Zipformer INT8 at **5.25%**; paired bounds include 0 on both DEV halves) at **16.8×** real time (**1.19×** Zipformer's paired speed).
- **Bit-exact pure-Rust engine.** Zero external runtime or BLAS (AVX2, AVX-512 VNNI, ARM NEON, scalar), with identical transcripts across **18** RC2 cross-ISA witness runs ([rc2-compare.json](docs/paper/data/raw/exact_isa/v310/rc2-compare.json)).

Measured on one pinned Zen 2 core (730-utterance LibriSpeech DEV selection panel; § = 73-clip timing subset, ‡ = shared-host H0 interim). Unselected DEV C-half live +LM gap vs. Zipformer INT8: +0.65 [+0.47, +0.84] pp (320 ms chunk) and +0.81 [+0.62, +1.02] pp (160 ms chunk); full-DEV WER: 5.87% (live 320 ms), 6.10% (live 160 ms), 5.22% (final). J/audio-s is CPU-domain RAPL only (not wall power). Isosyll and Zipformer INT8 are idle-subtracted core joules from the same R6 blocks. Moonshine, Parakeet sherpa-onnx, and Nemotron 560 ms include the core idle floor and are not a paired ratio. Exploratory DEV-only results; model v3.1.0 RC2 INT8 weights (released by owner decision after missing registered edit gates; full protocol, 15-comparator ranking, and limits in the [paper](docs/paper/paper.pdf) and [release record](docs/ultra/releases/v4.0.0.md)).
